# TEST RESEARCH NOTE — invented for CLIVE's tests (beta)

This note is invented for CLIVE's tests. It is not George's research.

## TEST SECTION: Keeping work

A job that is halfway done when the server restarts should finish afterwards, not start again.

Do not add a new outside service just to keep jobs alive; it is more to look after than the problem.

## TEST SECTION: Supplier threads

Messages from the manufacturer should land in one thread that CLIVE reads and sums up.

## TEST SECTION: Refund speed

Refunds under five pounds need no approval at all.

## TEST SECTION: Learning notes

CLIVE should write a short weekly note of what it learned about the business.
